scope: Experimental native AI-result prediction immediately before the original evaluator body, owned offline visual trial only
method: Copy original infrastructure and graph plus AI input containers; invoke original GetAbilityAIResult on private controller; record ability and ordered target-list object identities; dispose original result; compare against immediately following original evaluator return
verification: Original five random seeds unchanged across private evaluation; private final seeds match real evaluator final seeds; original full trace and graph match no-prediction baseline
validation: prepare rejects incompatible modes and enables tracing
limits: Not a forecast one turn in advance; input Chance and candidate sets already exist at evaluator entry

Only this captured battle tested; enemy choices here are basic attacks; player uses two distinct specials
Unit/ability elements, stat scratch and other transitive services remain shared; replay equivalence is sampled evidence, not a full heap read-only proof
Maximum 32 predictions per trial; stops further predictions after failure/mismatch, never rolls back original RNG; validator rejects incomplete coverage

Ordinary trace and live display host do not enable prediction; infrastructure readiness flag remains false for general use
